ads.headline: Lead generation interest surging; service businesses must act now
actions: Audit your current lead gen campaigns for conversion tracking accuracy
Test lead magnet offers (free quotes, inspections) at $25/day to capture demand
Create mobile-optimized landing pages since service searches spike on phones
ads.source: Google Trends (lead generation 26 vs meta ads 24) + r/FacebookAds trending discussions

creative.headline: POV-style talking head hooks outperforming every other format this week
actions: Open with: 'POV: you just spent $500 on ads and got zero leads — here's the exact reason why'
Film a 30s talking head: start mid-sentence like you're already explaining something urgent. No intro. No 'hey guys'. Straight into the pain point. End with DM me ADS.
Avoid posting carousels this week — algorithmic reach for static posts is down, Reels are getting 3-5x more distribution

critic.headline: Meta Conversion API not firing—tracking what actually converts
actions: Verify Conversion API is installed AND firing on thank-you/confirmation pages for each service business client
Check Ads Manager Events Manager for data gaps between pixel and server-side events in past 7 days
Compare reported conversions to actual CRM bookings—if they don't match, you're bidding blind and overpaying for false leads
critic.source: Meta ads communities reporting tracking breakage after recent iOS updates and API changes
